title: Puebla vs Pumas LIVE Score Updates in Liga MX Match
text:
Angulo strikes in the 90th minute as Pumas UNAM beat Puebla 1-2 in Liga MX - VAVEL USA

 Liga MX Matchday 15 See standings 
 Puebla 1 – 2 Pumas UNAM Moreno 23' Juninho 10' Angulo 90' FULL TIME Angulo strikes in the 90th minute as Pumas UNAM beat Puebla 1-2 in Liga MX
 Pumas UNAM defeated Puebla 2-1 in Liga MX with goals from Angulo. Watch the highlights, key stats and full match recap on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Gabriel Garcia Updated October 31, 2026, 1:26 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 1:26 AM ET Oct 31 1:21 AM ET 11 minutes ago End of the Match
 Pumas won and remain in contention. What a finish for the university team, which won 1-2. Juninho scored first, Moreno tied it up for La Franja, and late in the match, Angulo scored the winning goal for the university team, keeping them in the running for the playoffs.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Key moments
 1:21 AM ET End of the Match 
 1:10 AM ET 95' Goal · Pumas UNAM 
 1:08 AM ET 90' Goal by Álvaro Angulo · 1-2 
 12:36 AM ET 60' Red card · It Pumas... 
 12:21 AM ET 45' The second half is underway 
 12:06 AM ET Halftime 
 11:38 PM ET 23' Goal by Omar Moreno · 1-1 
 11:24 PM ET 10' Goal by Juninho · 0-1 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 95' Oct 31 1:10 AM ET 21 minutes ago That goal was a real blow
 That goal by Pumas to win at the last minute against La Franja was a real blow; scoring the equalizer looks like a tough task now that they lack clarity on offense and Pumas are holding their ground. Angulo’s goal was a great one, keeping Pumas’ hopes alive as they look ahead to the playoffs. Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 90' Oct 31 1:08 AM ET 24 minutes ago Goal by Angulo—Pumas take the win!
 Goal! Goal! Goal! For the Pumas—Angulo. What a finish to the game—they’re going to win it! A cross into the box off a corner kick by Carrasquilla, headed by Nathan, then blocked by Gutierrez, but the ball fell right to Angulo, who headed it in.
 Seven minutes of stoppage time have been added.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 85' Oct 31 1:04 AM ET 27 minutes ago With five minutes left, the game is still underway.
 With five minutes left, the game is still underway. It’s been a very even match that, so far, has left both teams with a bad taste in their mouths because they were expecting more dangerous plays and more goals. We’ll see if anything else happens on offense.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 80' Oct 31 1:03 AM ET 28 minutes ago Ten minutes into the game
 Ten minutes into the game, it's still a back-and-forth affair—truly even. We're expecting another goal, but no one is creating clear chances on offense. It feels like this match, which promised more, needs another goal, but the pace of the game has slowed down.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 75' Oct 31 1:02 AM ET 29 minutes ago Puebla and Pumas continue to play their Matchday 15
 Puebla and Pumas continue to play their Matchday 15 game, with no real danger in either penalty area and the match remaining very even. We'll see if either team dares to push for more and win it in what promises to be a nail-biting finish.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 70' Oct 31 12:47 AM ET 44 minutes ago With twenty minutes left
 With twenty minutes left, neither team has created any new scoring threats. We'll see if anyone decides to push for more; when Pumas makes a substitution—taking out Huerta and bringing in Arteaga—we'll see how the game changes.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 65' Oct 31 12:43 AM ET an hour ago The pace of the game has picked up
 The pace of the game has picked up at this stage, but Puebla is unable to move the ball into the opponent's half, while Pumas is circulating the ball more effectively and gradually closing in on the goal defended by goalkeeper Rodríguez.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 60' Oct 31 12:36 AM ET an hour ago It was a red card for Pumas...
 The red card against Pumas is rescinded... But after a VAR review, it was ruled a direct free kick and only a yellow card for the Panamanian Adalberto Carrasquilla; the university team, which had lost control of the match, has been spared. Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 58' Oct 31 12:34 AM ET an hour ago The match is nearing the one-hour mark
 The match is nearing the one-hour mark; the pace remains slow at this stage of the game. La Franja’s substitutes have yet to make an impact, and Pumas are gradually taking control of the tempo, attempting to attack without a clear plan by playing long balls.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 55' Oct 31 12:30 AM ET an hour ago Substitutions.
 Substitutions. La Franja makes the first moves, sending Ignacio Maestro Puch and Kevin Velasco onto the field to replace LuiFer Hernández and Garnica. Fresh legs are brought in to try to pick up the pace of the game.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 50' Oct 31 12:27 AM ET an hour ago The start of the second half has been low-intensity
 The start of the second half has been low-intensity; it’s been a tough stretch for Pumas, who are spending most of their time in their own half while Puebla is looking to push forward. The pace of the game will gradually pick up, as expected from these two teams.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 45' Oct 31 12:21 AM ET an hour ago The second half is underway
 The second half is now underway. Both teams are coming out with the same lineups as at halftime—the same 22 players who finished the first half. We’re in for a great second half, in which both teams will surely look to push for more, knowing how important this match is.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Oct 31 12:16 AM ET an hour ago The goals
 These were the goals scored in the first half. Juninho opened the scoring for the Pumas, and Moreno tied the game.
 ¡Qué clase de delantero es Juninho! 😤🐾
El GOLEADOR de los @PumasMX marcó el primero de la noche en el Cuauhtémoc con este TREMENDO recurso.
#LaLigaDeLaAfición✨ | #J15 | #AP26 | #PUEUNAM https://t.co/B0d8mOfxod
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 31, 2026 ¡Y así lo empató el Pueblooooooota! 🎽 💥
Omar Moreno apareció solo dentro del área para anotar el primero del @ClubPueblaMX esta noche. 🩵
#LaLigaDeLaAfición✨ | #J15 | #AP26 | #PUEUNAM https://t.co/7GJcpM9bhe
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 31, 2026 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Oct 31 12:11 AM ET an hour ago First-half analysis and key takeaways
 The match has been more evenly matched toward the end, following Puebla's goal after Pumas took an early lead thanks to Juninho. It promises to be an entertaining second half between these two teams, both looking to move closer to the playoff zone and secure a spot among the top 8 teams.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Oct 31 12:06 AM ET an hour ago Halftime
 The first half is over. Toward the end, Pumas missed a clear scoring opportunity: Antuna played a magnificent ball down to Huerta, who failed to finish it off—he blasted it over the net just as the goalkeeper was coming off his line. We’ll see what happens in the second half.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 45' Oct 31 12:00 AM ET 2 hours ago The pace of the game picks up in these
 The pace of the game picks up in these final minutes as Puebla takes control of the ball and Pumas stays back, waiting and closing down spaces. We'll see what happens in this final stretch, with 5 additional minutes added to the first half.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 40' 11:55 PM ET 2 hours ago The pace of the game was sporadic as Pumas
 The pace of the game was sporadic as Pumas gradually picked up the tempo on offense and created a good scoring opportunity, but Puebla’s defense got tangled up while trying to clear the ball, and the play came to nothing. Puebla played on the counterattack, keeping an eye on open spaces, with 5 minutes remaining plus stoppage time.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 35' 11:48 PM ET 2 hours ago The university team's defense looks very vulnerable at
 The university team's defense looks very vulnerable at the back every time Puebla attacks; they dominate and find openings down the middle. Armenta sent a warning shot with a strike that hit the post, and Navas made a great save to deflect it for a corner kick. Pumas have lost their footing in the match.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 30' 11:44 PM ET 2 hours ago Half an hour in, and the game is still
 Half an hour in, and the game is still moving at a brisk pace. La Franja came very close to scoring an own goal after a dangerous cross that Vargas tried to clear but ended up putting into his own net; on the next play, Huerta took a shot, but Rodríguez made the save.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 27' 11:41 PM ET 2 hours ago Pumas are on the attack
 Pumas are on the attack, looking to shake off the pressure caused by the own goal, but they lack clarity in midfield as Puebla applies better pressure to retain possession and look to improve their attack, while medical staff attend to Puebla’s Almada, who took a blow to the face.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 23' 11:38 PM ET 2 hours ago Goal for Puebla! Moreno ties the game
 Goal! Goal! Goal! Goal! La Franja tied the game with a nice play that led to Luifer Hernández, who held onto the ball despite intense pressure from the defense and chose to pass to Moreno, who finished right next to the post as Navas came off his line.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 20' 11:34 PM ET 2 hours ago The visiting team regained the offensive
 The visiting team regained the offensive, attacking more effectively in an effort to extend their lead. They advanced down the right flank, and after sending a cross into the box, the Puebla goalkeeper feigned a charge but stopped halfway. Antuna was poised to take the shot but failed to connect.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 18' 11:33 PM ET 2 hours ago The intensity of the match has gradually decreased.
 The intensity of the match has gradually decreased. La Franja has been attacking but still can’t find the back of the net against Keylor Navas. Pachuca and Almada collided heads; Rodrigo Pachuca was the one who came away with the more serious injury, but he’s able to continue playing.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 13' 11:27 PM ET 2 hours ago What a miss—that was the equalizer!
 What a miss—that was the equalizer! A great play off a corner kick: Organista took a shot right on the goal line, but it was poorly executed, and the equalizer slipped away. La Franja is lamenting the missed opportunity to tie the game.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10' 11:24 PM ET 2 hours ago Goal for the Pumas—Juninho!
 Goal! Goal! Goal! Goal for the Pumas! They moved the ball from side to side until it reached Rodrigo Lopez on the right, who delivered a great cross. Juninho anticipated it and scored with a backheel to open the scoring.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 5' 11:20 PM ET 2 hours ago The match got off to a fast-paced start.
 The match got off to a fast-paced start. Puebla is moving the ball from side to side for now after regaining possession, but Pumas had the first chance with a deep pass into Antuna’s area; he shot just over La Franja’s goal.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 1' 11:14 PM ET 2 hours ago The ball is rolling at Cuauhtémoc Stadium!
 The ball is rolling at Cuauhtémoc Stadium! Puebla and Pumas are already facing off in their Matchday 15 clash of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura. The match kicks off on Puebla’s home turf—let’s see who comes out on top in what promises to be an intense showdown.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 11:06 PM ET 2 hours ago All set
 The players are already on the field going through the pre-game routine! A great matchup is coming up at Cuauhtémoc Stadium. Stay tuned to this broadcast so you don't miss a thing in this Puebla vs. Pumas game!
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:55 PM ET 3 hours ago Pumas' Starting XI
 For the gold-and-blue team, Esteban Solari has fielded these eleven players in hopes of taking home three points from La Franja's home field:
 J15 | EL XI ANTE PUEBLA 🐾👊⚽️
#SiemprePumas #FutbolEnTusManos @Telcel https://t.co/wsh1J3wTUd
— PUMAS (@PumasMX) October 31, 2026 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:52 PM ET 3 hours ago Puebla's Starting XI
 Here are the 11 players Gerardo Espínoza is fielding in hopes of winning tonight's home game against the university team:
 Listo nuestro XI inicial para enfrentar a los Felinos 🐱
Entrega, confianza y compromiso de todos 🫡 ¡VAMOS PUEBLA! 🔵
#LaFranjaNosUne🎽 https://t.co/A5A8kyOYRB
— Club Puebla🎽 (@ClubPueblaMX) October 31, 2026 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:48 PM ET 3 hours ago They're already warming up
 The players from both teams are doing their warm-up exercises and putting the finishing touches on their preparations for the match. This will be a crucial match for both teams if they want to keep their playoff hopes alive; a loss would eliminate either one.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:45 PM ET 3 hours ago Recent history favors the university team
 Pumas comes into the match with a favorable record against Puebla, having recorded five wins and one draw in their last six meetings. In addition, they have won three of their last three visits to Cuauhtémoc Stadium, a streak they will look to extend tonight when the two clubs face off.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:42 PM ET 3 hours ago Cuauhtémoc Stadium Is Ready
 Everything is set at Cuauhtémoc Stadium for this matchup between La Franja and the Pumas. The fact that the two teams are so close in the standings adds a special element to the game, as only one point separates Puebla from the Pumas.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:40 PM ET 3 hours ago Puebla vs Pumas UNAM Live Score, Confirmed Lineups & Match Stats
 Follow Puebla vs Pumas UNAM live score , confirmed starting XI and lineups, real-time goals, match stats, Liga MX standings and minute-by-minute highlights from Estadio Cuauhtémoc on VAVEL.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:38 PM ET 3 hours ago We're Back
 Cuauhtémoc Stadium will host this match, part of Matchday 15 of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura. Both teams are coming into the game needing to earn points to stay in the hunt for a spot in the Liguilla, with only three matchdays remaining in the regular season.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:24 PM ET 3 hours ago How to watch Puebla vs Pumas UNAM Live Stream, TV Channel & Kick-off Times
 Here are the official kick-off times, TV channels and live stream options to watch Puebla vs Pumas UNAM in Liga MX across major English-speaking regions:
 USA: 11:00 PM EDT / 8:00 PM PDT — TV & Live Stream on ESPN+, Paramount+, Peacock, fuboTV .
 UK & Ireland: 3:00 AM GMT — Watch live on Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Discovery+ .
 South Africa & Sub-Saharan Africa (Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Uganda): 5:00 AM SAST (4:00 AM WAT in Nigeria / 6:00 AM EAT in Kenya & Uganda) — Broadcast on SuperSport, DStv Stream .
 Canada: 11:00 PM EDT / 8:00 PM PDT — Live streaming on DAZN Canada, FuboTV Canada, TSN .
 Australia & New Zealand: 2:00 PM AEDT (4:00 PM NZDT in New Zealand) — Watch live on Optus Sport, beIN Sports Australia, Stan Sport .
 UAE & MENA (Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Qatar): 7:00 AM GST (6:00 AM AST in Saudi Arabia & Qatar) — Broadcast on beIN Sports English, TOD .
 India, Malaysia & Singapore: 8:30 AM IST (11:00 AM MYT/SGT in Malaysia & Singapore) — Watch on Sony LIV, Star Sports (India), Astro SuperSport (Malaysia) .
 For real-time Puebla vs Pumas UNAM live score updates , confirmed starting lineups, match stats and minute-by-minute commentary, follow VAVEL right here.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:55 PM ET 4 hours ago Three matchdays remain, and there’s little room for error if they want to make the playoffs
 The schedule is starting to get tight for Puebla and Pumas. At this stage of the season, with three matchdays remaining after this one, neither team can afford to drop points if they want to stay in contention for the playoffs. Pumas have 17 points, just one more than Puebla, which has 16. 
This matchup will be crucial for both teams if they want to stay in the running. A win wouldn’t guarantee them a spot in the playoffs, but it would allow them to close in on the top eight and head into the final stretch with better prospects. That’s why, in addition to playing well, it will be important to handle the pressure and capitalize on any opportunities that arise. Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:25 PM ET 4 hours ago Robert Morales: Speed and Threat for Pumas
 Robert Morales will be one of the players to watch on the Pumas roster. The Paraguayan forward provides depth on the offensive front and will look to capitalize on any opportunities that arise against the Puebla defense. “La Pantera” is on a roll after scoring a good against Tigres last matchday.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8:53 PM ET 5 hours ago Luifer Hernández, the Player to Watch for Puebla
 Luifer Hernández will be one of the players to watch closely on the Puebla squad. La Franja needs to find solutions on offense to take advantage of its home-field advantage and secure three points that could make a difference in the fight for a playoff spot. The player is in good form after scoring a good in the last match against Atlas.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8:18 PM ET 5 hours ago Recent Head-to-Head Record Between Puebla and Pumas
 The most recent matchups between Puebla and Pumas show a clear advantage for the Universitarios, who have five wins and one draw in their last six games against La Franja.
The most recent matchup between the two teams took place in the 2026 Clausura, when Pumas came back from a two-goal deficit to win 3-2 on Puebla’s home turf. Prior to that match, the teams played to a scoreless draw in the 2025 Apertura. In their other most recent meetings, Pumas defeated La Franja 3-1 in the 2025 Clausura, won 1-0 in the 2024 Apertura, and prevailed 3-0 in the 2024 Clausura. Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:45 PM ET 6 hours ago Pumas Aims to Break into the Playoff Zone and Keep Their Hopes Alive
 Pumas enters this matchday in 12th place in the overall standings, with 17 points. Their current position still allows them to fight for a spot among the top eight, but the window of opportunity to climb the standings is narrowing. With three matchdays remaining after this game, the university team needs to make the most of the upcoming matches and avoid setbacks that could derail their hopes.
 The trip to Puebla represents an important opportunity because they’ll face a direct rival, separated by just one point in the standings. A win would allow the blue-and-yellows to extend their lead and catch their breath in the race.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:45 PM ET 6 hours ago Puebla Knows It Can Still Close the Gap on the Playoff Spots
 La Franja heads into this match in 14th place in the standings, with 16 points, and knows it has a key opportunity to improve its position. The gap between them and Pumas is just one point, so a win would allow them to overtake Pumas and close the gap on the teams in the playoff spots.
 The match comes in the final stretch of the season, when there isn’t much room left to make up ground: after this matchday, there will be only three games remaining in the regular season.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:45 PM ET 6 hours ago Cuauhtémoc Stadium
 Cuauhtémoc Stadium will host this matchup on Matchday 15 of Liga MX. Puebla’s home stadium will be the venue for a crucial game for both teams’ aspirations, as they are separated by just one point and need to improve their standing in the standings.
 For La Franja, playing in front of their home crowd represents an opportunity to seek a victory and put behind them the losing streak that has marked their recent matchups against Pumas.
 The Universitarios, for their part, will try to maintain the dominance they’ve shown against the Camoteros and take advantage of the away game to earn three points that will allow them to close in on the top eight spots.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:45 PM ET 6 hours ago Hello to all VAVEL readers!
 Welcome to the live broadcast of the match between Puebla and Pumas, part of Matchday 15 of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura, which will take place at Cuauhtémoc Stadium.
 My name is Gabriel García, and I’ll be your host for this match, which could be crucial for both teams’ aspirations. Follow our live coverage for confirmed starting lineups, real-time score updates, match stats, standings and highlights.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
